timingNotes.issue: Narration returned ~69s against a 60s target on every generation; the seed_audio speech_rate parameter proved to have little effect on full lines (an early probe suggesting otherwise was per-generation variance).
timingNotes.resolution: Recovered time without degrading the read: trimmed clip-edge silence, compressed over-long internal sentence pauses to 0.28s, then applied a mild 1.13x tempo. Speech totals 57.47s; the remaining 2.53s is head, inter-beat gaps and an 0.75s CTA tail.
timingNotes.rejectedAlternative: A 1.17x+ time-stretch with no pause compression, which would have audibly rushed the delivery the user selected the voice for.

src/studio/qa.ts: CTA check only matched the legacy 'cta' scene type and flagged every archetype project as missing a CTA
scripts/assemble-audio.ts: sidechaincompress terminates with its key input, truncating the mix at the last spoken word and leaving the held CTA in digital silence; key is now padded to full length
